title: Robin boundary conditions in global AdS$_4$: exact double-trace thermodynamics and a soft-mode instability
summary: We consider a conformally coupled scalar field in four-dimensional global anti-de Sitter space with Robin boundary conditions, parametrized by an angle $α$. On the boundary cylinder $\mathbb{R}\times S^{2}$ these conditions realize the double-trace deformation $\tfrac12λ\!\int O^{2}$ of the dimension-one operator $O$ in the alternate quantization with $λ=\cotα/L$.
